qualification.details: Manager : MBA and 6 to 8 years of relevant experience

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Manager Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Manager (Events) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Manager (Events) post at IIT Madras is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Manager (Events) post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Manager (Events) post in the IIT Madras recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Madras Manager (Events) Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Manager (Events) post at IIT Madras is Online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Manager (Events) position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Manager (Events) position will receive a salary of Rs. 100000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Manager (Events) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA degree along with 6 to 8 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Manager (Events) post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Madras Manager (Events) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Madras Manager (Events) recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Manager (Events) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Manager (Events) post includes a Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Manager (Events) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Manager (Events) post is Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website to apply and find more details about the recruitment is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. When was the notification for IIT Madras Manager (Events) released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Madras Manager (Events) recruitment was released on 17 August 2026.
